newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils lower, tropicals little changed in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils lower, tropicals little changed in Europe.

text.p: Soft oil prices opened lower in Europe on Thursday following the set back in Chicago overnight.

Chicago futures closed lower on Wednesday on rumours that China had purchased supplies from South America and unconfirmed press reports that an Indiana rose grower may have died from Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD).
CJD is the human form of Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE), "madcow disease".
Dutch soy oil opened with sellers 0.50 to 0.75 guilders down and rape oil 0.25 to 0.50 guilders lower.
Palm oil was little changed at the opening with sellers unchanged to $5 up.
"Prices are up slightly ahead of the holiday in Malaysia on Friday." said a trader.
Coconut oil offers were unchanged to $2.50 down while palmkernel oil was $10 up with buyers and sellers eyeing each other from a distance.
